FieldWorks https://fieldworks.example.test | Senior SWE, AI Automation Engr, Senior PM | REMOTE (US+INTL for eng, US for product & automations)

FieldWorks builds an AI-powered back office for small trade businesses. We pair office managers with AI agents that take over paperwork end to end, and we are expanding product and engineering.

- Senior Software Engineer, AI Full Stack: ship AI-native React experiences and the Node services behind them. https://fieldworks.example.test/careers?job=role-0001

- Senior Software Engineer, Voice AI & Data Infrastructure: own real-time voice agents and data pipelines https://fieldworks.example.test/careers?job=role-0002

- AI Automation Engineer: turn small-business workflows into automations. https://fieldworks.example.test/careers?job=role-0003

- Senior Product Manager, AI Agents: own the agents at the core of the product, including the evals that prove they work. https://fieldworks.example.test/careers?job=role-0004

All roles require working hours that overlap with 11am-3pm ET.
